remarks: Discover a unique opportunity to live in a beautifully remodeled, very private 2 bedroom, 1 bath lower-floor apartment with windows opening to the street level, surrounded by gorgeously landscaped grounds. This nice apartment features a spacious living with large windows that fill the rooms with natural light. The apartment offers 2 well-proportioned bedrooms, including large closet spaces, as well as beautiful hardwood floors and fresh colorful paint throughout the apartment. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with new appliances. Nice full bath. Private, on-site parking for 2 vehicles is available for request and monitored by a surveillance cameras for your peace of mind. Additional large personal storage room/s will be available in the next 6 months. Conveniently located just minutes from vibrant downtown Norwalk and The SoNo Collection. This home combines comfort, privacy, and convenience. Schedule your private showing and experience all this home has to offer at a great value.
